desc:
• CAKE MIX: Bake a delicious, fluffy angel food cake dessert

  • QUICK AND EASY: From the box to the oven in minutes! Perfect for parties or to make at a moment's notice

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Add your own twist to this cake mix by trying tested and trusted Betty Crocker recipes

  • FLUFFY SWEETNESS: Fluffy, slightly chewy and satisfyingly sweet; Betty Crocker brings you the same fresh-baked favorites you've known and loved all your life

  • CONTAINS: 16 oz
features:
Features

Classic Light and Fluffy Texture
Creates a traditional angel food cake that is airy, soft, and spongy, perfectly moist in every bite.

Just Add Water
Requires only one ingredient—water. No need for oil, eggs, or butter, making prep incredibly simple.

Fat-Free Dessert Option
Contains zero grams of fat per serving, making it a lighter choice for those watching their intake.

Large 16 oz Box
Makes one full-size angel food cake—ideal for parties, family desserts, or layered cakes.

Easy-to-Follow Instructions
Designed for beginner bakers and busy home cooks alike with foolproof results.

No Artificial Flavors or Preservatives
Clean and simple ingredients without unnecessary additives.

Box Tops for Education Eligible
Participates in the Box Tops program, helping support schools with every purchase.

Benefits

Effortless Baking Experience
Get a homemade-style dessert with minimal prep—just mix, pour, and bake.

Healthier Dessert Option
Fat-free and lower in calories, it’s a smart choice for guilt-free indulgence.

Reliable Every Time
Delivers consistently tall, fluffy cakes that slice cleanly and look beautiful on the table.

Perfect Base for Creative Desserts
Pairs beautifully with fruit, whipped cream, chocolate drizzle, or light frosting for custom desserts.

Family and Guest Favorite
A crowd-pleasing treat that's great for birthdays, holidays, or everyday enjoyment.

Great for All Skill Levels
Whether you’re an expert baker or a complete beginner, you’ll get bakery-style results with ease.
ingredients: Sugar, Wheat Flour Bleached, Egg White, Corn Starch, Baking Soda, Citric Acid, Calcium Phosphate, Salt, Cellulose Gum, Artificial Flavor, Sodium Lauryl Sulfate (a whipping aid).
